resources.string: Lets the keyboard read the conversation or form on screen, and tap Send for replies you allowed Autopilot to send. Nothing leaves your phone.

When enabled, Agent Keyboard reads the text of the app you are typing in (for example, the last messages of a chat or the labels of a form) only while the keyboard is open, so replies and form-fill suggestions match the context. If you turn on Autopilot for an agent and a chat app, it may also tap that app\'s Send button after typing a reply you allowed. It never reads password fields, secure screens, or apps on your blocklist, never submits forms, and never acts on payments. Everything stays on your device.
